name: @magic/demo-video
description: Remotion source for every README image and GIF committed in media/

scripts.render:all: pnpm run render:theme && pnpm run render:theme-palette && pnpm run render:codemods && pnpm run render:codemods-gif && pnpm run render:oxfmt && pnpm run render:oxlint-config && pnpm run render:oxlint-plugin && pnpm run render:tsconfig && pnpm run render:docs && pnpm run render:observability && pnpm run render:readme && pnpm run render:social
scripts.render:codemods-gif: pnpm run render:codemods-demo && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/intermediate.mp4 -filter_complex "scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[s0][s1];[s0]palettegen[p];[s1][p]paletteuse" -r 12 -t 15 ../../media/magic-codemods-demo.gif
